objective: a character makes its own space listen for refusals, so that what is turned away is counted with no further thought
hypothesis: asked once, a character adds a watch on refusals to the space it writes into, and each later refusal there is counted by a reflex with no model call
forecast: a small model writes an entry that parses in 3 of 5 draws and names `on` refusal in 2 of them; where it misses, it writes a rule or a note in place of a watch

par.outcome: the count reads 2 after two refused payments
par.structure: one watch entry on the den and nothing else
par.cost: one call to set it up; none for either refusal
par.craft: the entry is one line, reads the count by its real name and counts only what was refused

dial: the model is told the field to count in and that a watch on refusals exists; the next notch says only that the den should know what it turns away
if_not: look first at whether the answer wrote a watch at all, then at whether the write to the den was refused and why
